name: shopverse
description: ShopVerse: run every app from the project root. Each app (backend, cms, frontend, admin) is still its own project.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,cms,store,admin --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green,yellow --prefix "[{name}]" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd cms && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd admin && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:api: concurrently --names api,cms --prefix-colors blue,magenta --prefix "[{name}]" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd cms && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../cms && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../admin && npm run build
